text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki thought that pushing herself 
to the limit might lead her to true 
"obsession." She spent every single day 
entirely devoted to training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sensing that things were heading in a bad 
direction, the Trainer decided she needed 
a change of pace and invited her to watch 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) buzzed with 
excitement over the direct showdown 
between Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And during the race, Yaeno Muteki realized 
that Oguri Cap harbored a fierce 
"obsession" with Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even the calm and composed Oguri Cap has 
reached a state of "obsession." Yaeno 
Muteki finds herself deeply troubled over 
why she cannot reach it herself.
